arxiv-1808-09054.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by . Higgs boson production cross-sections in proton–proton collisions are measured in the H → W ​ W ∗ → e ​ ν ​ μ ​ ν H{\rightarrow\,}WW^{\ast}{\rightarrow\,}e\nu\mu\nu decay channel. The proton–proton collision data were produced at the Large Hadron Collider at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 TeV and recorded by the ATLAS detector in 2015 and 2016, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 36.1 fb -1 .

arxiv-2012-08880.title: Instanton induced transverse single spin asymmetry for π 0 \pi^{0} production in p ​ p pp -scattering
arxiv-2012-08880.creator: N.Korchagin, N.Kochelev, Pengming Zhang
arxiv-2012-08880.description: Abstract We calculate the production cross-section and the transverse single-spin asymmetry for pion in p ↑ + p → π 0 + X p^{\uparrow}+p\to\pi^{0}+X . Our computation is based on existence of the instanton induced effective quark-gluon and quark-gluon-pion interactions with a strong spin dependency. In this framework we calculate the cross section without using fragmentation functions.

arxiv-2103-03428.title: Self-compression of stimulated Raman backscattering by flying focus
arxiv-2103-03428.creator: Z. Wu, Y. Zuo, Z. Zhang, X. Wang, J. Mu, X.D. Wang, B. Hu, J. Su, Z. Li, X. Wei, X. Zeng
arxiv-2103-03428.description: Abstract A novel regime of self-compression is proposed for plasma-based backward Raman amplification(BRA) upon flying focus. By using a pumping focus moving with a speed equal to the group velocity of stimulated Raman backscattering(SRBS), only a short part of SRBS which does always synchronize with the flying focus can be amplified.

arxiv-2212-08288.title: Further Properties of PPT and Hyponormal Matrices
arxiv-2212-08288.creator: Hamid Reza Moradi, Ibrahim Halil Gümüş, and Mohammad Sababheh
arxiv-2212-08288.description: Abstract . This paper discusses further properties of positive partial transpose matrices, with applications towards hyponormal, semi-hyponormal, and ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) -normal matrices. The obtained results present extensions and improvements of many results in the literature. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 15A45, 47A30; Secondary 15A42, 47A63, 47B65 1.

arxiv-2301-11052.title: Energy extraction from Janis-Newman-Winicour naked singularity
arxiv-2301-11052.creator: Vishva Patel, Kauntey Acharya, Parth Bambhaniya, Pankaj S. Joshi
arxiv-2301-11052.description: Abstract In general, energy extraction methods such as the Penrose process and the magnetic Penrose process are thought to be reliant on the existence of an ergoregion. Inside an ergoregion, there are negative energy states that allow a particle to extract energy and escape to an observer at infinity.

arxiv-2304-10454.title: Holographic complexity of hyperbolic black holes arXiv: 2304.10454
arxiv-2304-10454.creator: Yongao Wang and Jie Ren
arxiv-2304-10454.description: Abstract We calculate the holographic complexity of a family of hyperbolic black holes in an Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton (EMD) system by applying the complexity=action (CA) conjecture. While people previously studied spherical black holes in the same system, we show that hyperbolic black holes have intriguing features.

arxiv-2402-07947.title: Fundamentals of Stars: Critical Looks at Mass-Luminosity Relations and Beyond Volume: 0
arxiv-2402-07947.creator: Z. Eker 1 ​ \cc {}^{1\cc} \orcid 0000-0003-1883-6255, F. Soydugan 2,3 \orcid 0000-0002-5141-7645 and S. Bilir 4 \orcid 0000-0003-3510-1509 \affsep 1 Akdeniz University, Faculty of Sciences, Department of Space Sciences and Technologies, 07058, Antalya, Türkiye 2 Çanakkale Onsekiz Mart University, Fa
arxiv-2402-07947.description: Abstract Developments on various relations among stellar variables such as the main sequence empirical mass-luminosity (MLR), mass-radius (MRR) and mass-effective temperature (MTR) relations were reviewed. Conceptual changes on their understanding and usages were discussed. After its discovery, MLR was treated as one of the fundamental secrets of the cosmos, at least until questioned by the end of the 20th century.

arxiv-2506-06938.title: Experimental Evaluation of Static Image Sub-Region-Based Search Models Using CLIP
arxiv-2506-06938.creator: Bastian Jäckl, Vojtěch Kloda, Daniel A. Keim, Jakub Lokoč
arxiv-2506-06938.description: Abstract Advances in multimodal text-image models have enabled effective text-based querying in extensive image collections. While these models show convincing performance for everyday life scenes, querying in highly homogeneous, specialized domains remains challenging. The primary problem is that users can often provide only vague textual descriptions as they lack expert knowledge to discriminate between homogenous entities.

However, the post-operative subconjunctival scarring response which blocks filtration efficiency is a major hurdle to the achievement of long-term surgical

pmc-10667844.title: A 3D‐Printed Dual Driving Forces Scaffold with Self‐Promoted Cell Absorption for Spinal Cord Injury Repair
pmc-10667844.creator: Chen Qiu, Yuan Sun, Jinying Li, Jiayi Zhou, Yuchen Xu, Cong Qiu, Kang Yu, Jia Liu, Yuanqing Jiang, Wenyu Cui, Guanghao Wang, He Liu, Weixin Yuan, Tuoying Jiang, Yaohui Kou, Zhen Ge, Zhiying He, Shaomin Zhang, Yong He, Luyang Yu
pmc-10667844.description: Stem cells play critical roles in cell therapies and tissue engineering for nerve repair. However, achieving effective delivery of high cell density remains a challenge. Here, a novel cell delivery platform termed the hyper expansion scaffold (HES) is developed to enable high cell loading. HES facilitated self‐promoted and efficient cell absorption via a dual driving force model.

pmc-11290168.title: Multioviz: an interactive platform for in silico perturbation and interrogation of gene regulatory networks
pmc-11290168.creator: Helen Xie, Lorin Crawford, Ashley Mae Conard
pmc-11290168.description: In this paper, we aim to build a platform that will help bridge the gap between high-dimensional computation and wet-lab experimentation by allowing users to interrogate genomic signatures at multiple molecular levels and identify best next actionable steps for downstream decision making.

pmc-11430704.title: The Use of Audiovisual Distraction Tools in the Dental Setting for Pediatric Subjects with Special Healthcare Needs: A Review and Proposal of a Multi-Session Model for Behavioral Management
pmc-11430704.creator: Massimo Pisano, Alessia Bramanti, Giuseppina De Benedetto, Carmen Martin Carreras-Presas, Federica Di Spirito
pmc-11430704.description: Background: A Special Health Care Need (SHCN) is characterized by any type of physical, mental, sensorial, cognitive, emotional, or developmental condition that requires medical treatment, specialized services, or healthcare interventions. These conditions can negatively impact oral health as SHCN children can hardly cooperate or communicate and experience higher levels of dental fear/anxiety, which interfere with regular appointments.

pmc-11632061.title: Gastrointestinal quality of life in children born with gastroschisis
pmc-11632061.creator: Matilda Bräutigam, Michaela Dellenmark-Blom, Kate Abrahamsson, Cathrine Gatzinsky, Vladimir Gatzinsky
pmc-11632061.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeThe aim was to determine gastrointestinal (GI)-related QoL in children born with gastroschisis (GS).MethodsTotally, 58/83 families of children (aged 2–18 years) operated for GS at a tertiary pediatric surgical center accepted participation.

pmc-12566408.title: Effectiveness of Classic Triple Therapy Compared with Alternative Regimens for Eradicating H. pylori: A Systematic Review
pmc-12566408.creator: Majid Darraj, Iosif Marincu
pmc-12566408.description: Background: Helicobacter pylori infection is associated with peptic ulcer disease, chronic gastritis, and gastric cancer. Classic triple therapy (CTT) has been widely used, but increasing antibiotic resistance has reduced its effectiveness. Objectives: To evaluate the effectiveness of CTT compared with alternative regimens and to summarize adverse events and adherence.

pmc-12594012.title: MyGauchTM: a patient-centered digital health app for Gaucher disease
pmc-12594012.creator: Majdolen Istaiti, Elena Shulman, Tama Dinur, Dafna Frydman, Linda Harnevo, Moshe Farin, Ari Zimran, Shoshana Revel-Vilk
pmc-12594012.description: BackgroundGaucher disease (GD) is a rare genetic disorder caused by variants in the GBA1 gene, leading to a deficiency of β-glucocerebrosidase. This enzyme deficiency results in glucocerebroside accumulation in macrophages, forming “Gaucher” cells and causing symptoms such as hepatosplenomegaly, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and severe bone issues like osteonecrosis.

pmc-13277033.title: Beyond acrodynia: infantile mercury vapor poisoning presenting with refractory hypoglycemia and persistent neurological damage
pmc-13277033.creator: Shifan Wu, Qihan Yu, Jie Ying, Jiehong Xie, Kehan Wang, Guangfeng Liu, Hongbing Pang
pmc-13277033.description: Infantile elemental mercury poisoning is clinically rare and poses a severe long-term health threat. This report describes a rare case of non-accidental infantile elemental mercury poisoning, in which the infant was continuously exposed to mercury vapor for 20 days starting from postnatal day 15.

pmc-13501411.title: Impact of oral probiotics on oral health and halitosis in orthodontic patients treated with aligners or conventional fixed appliances vs placebo: two randomized clinical trials
pmc-13501411.creator: Georgios Vasoglou, Ioulia-Maria Mylonopoulou, Gerassimos Angelopoulos, Dimitrios Kloukos, Nikolaos Pandis, Iosif Sifakakis
pmc-13501411.description: BackgroundHalitosis is primarily caused by oral microbiota dysbiosis, exacerbated by orthodontic appliances that promote plaque retention. Probiotics offer a potential non-invasive strategy to rebalance oral flora and reduce volatile sulfur compounds (VSCs), but their clinical effectiveness remains largely underexplored in Orthodontics.

pmc-13599928.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of efavirenz versus ainuovirine in people living with HIV initiating first-line combination antiretroviral therapy
pmc-13599928.creator: Chenlu Yang, Yuanqi Mi, Yuhong Zeng, Feng Cheng, Huatang Zeng, Mengge Zhou
pmc-13599928.description: BackgroundAinuovirine (ANV), a new non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor, has been shown to have comparable effectiveness to efavirenz (EFV) with fewer adverse events. However, evidence on the cost-effectiveness of replacing EFV-based regimens with ANV-based regimens remains limited, particularly within the context of China’s National Free Antiretroviral Treatment Programme.
